headword: {一切合切|いっさいがっさい}

definitions.gloss: absolutely everything; the whole lot; lock, stock, and barrel
definitions.explanation: An emphatic expression meaning everything without exception. Stronger and more emphatic than {全部|ぜんぶ} or {一切|いっさい} alone.

examples.japanese: {一切合切|いっさいがっさい}{捨|す}ててしまった。
{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{時|とき}に{一切合切|いっさいがっさい}{処分|しょぶん}した。
examples.english: I disposed of the whole lot when I moved.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}のことは{一切合切|いっさいがっさい}{忘|わす}れて、{新|あたら}しい{生活|せいかつ}を{始|はじ}めたい。
examples.english: I want to forget absolutely everything about the past and start a new life.

notes:
A rhyming emphatic doubling of {一切|いっさい} (everything, all). The addition of {合切|がっさい} intensifies the meaning, emphasizing completeness — nothing is excluded. The rhythmic quality gives it a decisive, forceful tone.

USAGE:
Used when emphasizing that something applies to every single thing without exception. Often appears with verbs of disposal, forgetting, or giving up. More dramatic and emphatic than {全部|ぜんぶ} or {一切|いっさい} alone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一切合切|いっさいがっさい}{捨|す}てる — to throw away everything
- {一切合切|いっさいがっさい}{任|まか}せる — to entrust everything
- {一切合切|いっさいがっさい}{持|も}っていく — to take absolutely everything

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一切|いっさい} — all, everything; less emphatic, also used with negatives ({一切|いっさい}ない)
- {全部|ぜんぶ} — all, everything; neutral and everyday
- {根|ね}こそぎ — completely, from the roots; implies thorough removal
